_comment: EXAMPLE/TEMPLATE contract registry for Berachain (Task 9, design decision #8 amended by B3). Synthetic, obviously-fake addresses for everything EXCEPT the real BGT Distributor 0xd2f19a79... (a documented trusted constant cited from the design record, not a value invented here). The real per-user registry lives at resources/source/2025/berachain_contracts.json and is gitignored under resources/source/*. This file is the committed template that tests read. Per B3, NO Berachain contract carries operator_country here: all Berachain rewards resolve via the existing chain-level VG (British Virgin Islands, primary source: Berachain ToS) in operator_origin.py:305. A contract-level override requires a PRIMARY source stronger than the chain-level mapping; the KY/Cayman seed (Bitstamp MiCA whitepaper, secondary) was dropped.
